intent_rationale: The patient identifies changing work shifts and fatigue as obstacles, then directly asks for help finding workable options.
conversation_text:
Clinician: What has made it difficult to follow the meal plan you discussed last time?
Patient: My shifts change every week, and I often get home too tired to cook. Could you help me think of options that would work on late nights?
